subject: Urgent: ClarityBank high latency & error spike after v5 quant rollout
messages:
From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@claritybank.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@claritybank.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High latency & error spike after v5 quant rollout

Jasmine,

We pushed live against your v5 model yesterday (quant profile q-int8-v2) and started seeing serious issues across our payments flows this morning: p95 latency jumped from ~120ms to ~1.7s, end-to-end throughput dropped ~45%, and 5xx error rate is ~4.8% (was ~0.2% baseline). This is customer-impacting — transactions are timing out.

Attached: latency_histogram_20270405.png and svc_error_log_excerpt.txt with a few sample request IDs. We need an immediate mitigation plan and an exec-level escalation. Can you confirm whether this rollout included any kernel/quant changes that could explain a decode stall?

We are pausing live traffic for a subset of critical routes but still seeing errors on the remaining requests. Please advise next steps; if a rollback is required we need it prioritized.

—Alex Soto
Lead Platform Engineer, ClarityBank
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Soto <alex.soto@claritybank.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High latency & error spike after v5 quant rollout

Alex — thanks for the quick heads-up and the attachments. I’m escalating now. Marcus and Karthik: can your teams triage immediately (logs, kernel/quant insights) and propose a 30-min mitigation? Naomi, I’ll coordinate the exec call if we need to pull in ClarityBank leadership.

Short asks for triage:
- Confirm whether q-int8-v2 rolled globally vs per-region
- Identify any GPU kernel failures or decode stalls in the svc_error_log_excerpt
- Suggest immediate mitigation (rollback vs per-route fallback) and estimate RTO

We’ll treat this as an exec escalation until cleared. I’ll set a call in 30 minutes and include Lisa Park.

—Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, alex.soto@claritybank.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High latency & error spike after v5 quant rollout

Quick triage notes (preliminary):
- We see a significant uptick in KV cache miss rates on the ClarityBank route starting 2027-04-05 03:00 UTC coincident with q-int8-v2 being pushed.
- Several worker pods report repeated decode-time stalls correlated with the q-int8-v2 kernel selection path on Ampere-Next GPUs. The float16 path does not show this behavior.
- Attached: quant_profile.diff (diff between q-int8-v2 and q-int8-v1), svc_error_log_excerpt.txt (marked), and latency_histogram_20270405.png. I created JIRA-RED-1198 to track kernel selection race condition.

Immediate mitigation options:
1) Force route override for ClarityBank to use v5-nq (non-quantized variant) — low risk, quick (~10-20m) to route change.
2) Revert quant profile to q-int8-v1 for ClarityBank only — moderate risk, ~20-40m including validation.
3) Full rollback to v4.9 — highest scope, ~40-60m and will require coordination with releases.

Recommend option (1) as a fast, safe stopgap: it avoids a full rollback and isolates the issue to quant kernel selection. I’m standing by to push the route override.

—Marcus Lin
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, alex.soto@claritybank.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High latency & error spike after v5 quant rollout

Agree with Marcus. For clarity — this appears to be a kernel selection regression exposed by the new quant profile on a specific hardware family. We should:
- Execute action (1) immediately (route override to v5-nq)
- Schedule an 11:30 PST exec touchpoint with ClarityBank and our CTO (Riaz) if they request.
- Postmortem to cover gating criteria; add a canary step for quant profile switches.

Action items (owners):
- Marcus: push route override for ClarityBank (now)
- Naomi: confirm exec invite + share mutual action plan with ClarityBank procurement/legal
- Jasmine: provide customer comms and timeline
- Aditya: validate fallback telemetry and rollback hooks

I will stand by on the call.

—Karthik Iyer

Subject: Bridge summary & next steps — ClarityBank v5 quant incident

Team / ClarityBank leadership — short outcome summary and next steps after the 11:30 triage on 2027-04-05: 
- Mitigation executed: Marcus applied route override to v5-nq for ClarityBank at 2027-04-05 11:45 PST.
- Observed recovery: p95 latency returned to baseline (~130ms) and 5xx error rate fell to 0.3% by 12:10 PST on 2027-04-05. Throughput returned to expected range.
- Root cause (prelim): kernel-selection path for q-int8-v2 can hit a race/edge-case on Ampere-Next GPUs leading to decode stalls and increased KV cache misses. JIRA-RED-1198 created.

Immediate follow-ups (owners & ETA):
- Engineering (Marcus / Karthik): full root-cause analysis and fix for kernel-selection race (ETA 72h) — JIRA-RED-1198.
- Serving (Aditya): add per-customer canary gates for quant-profile switches and a quick-fallback toggle (ETA 5 business days).
- CS/Account (Naomi / Jasmine): customer comms and credit offer discussed on bridge; finalize language and send by EOD tomorrow.
- Legal/Procurement (internal): review mutual_action_plan_CL-4829.pdf and expedite any contract language for remedial credits (ongoing).

We will schedule a postmortem with ClarityBank and our leadership once the engineering fix is validated. Thank you to everyone for the quick action.

Attachments referenced: latency_histogram_20270405.png, quant_profile.diff, svc_error_log_excerpt.txt, mutual_action_plan_CL-4829.pdf

—Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
